name: Sennin Kabuto (S)
description: Having surpassed Orochimaru and perfected Sage Transformation through relentless experimentation, Kabuto Yakushi has become a living nexus of stolen power. His body endlessly adapts, assimilating DNA, techniques, and chakra with surgical precision.

skills.name: DNA Assimilation
skills.description: For the rest of the game, this skill will be replaced every turn by a random skill from any of Orochimaru's Finest Shinobi (Jiroubou, Sakon, Tayuya, Kidoumaru, Kimimaro). This skill cannot be removed or ignored.

skills.name: Inorganic Reanimation
skills.description: Kabuto targets all enemies, dealing 15 piercing damage to them, cancelling their delayed skills, and increasing the cost of their skills by 1 random chakra for 1 turn. If this successfully cancels a delayed skill, the enemy who used it will have their non-mental skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sage Art: White Rage
skills.description: For 1 turn, all enemies will have their cooldowns increased by 1 and be paralyzed. During this time, if they use a new harmful skill, it will be delayed for 1 turn. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Sage Art: Mystical Palm'.

skills.name: Cursed Seal Life-Giving
skills.description: Kabuto equalizes the health of himself and one ally. Afterwards, that ally heals 15 health has their active cooldowns reduced by 2. For 3 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'White Snake Bite'.

skills.name: Sage Art: Mystical Palm
skills.description: This skill deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and cancels any delayed skill of theirs. If this successfully cancels a delayed skill, the enemy who used it will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: White Snake Bite
skills.description:
Kabuto equalizes the health of himself and one enemy, then steals 25 health from them.
➤ Health Equalized: Add the health of both characters together, then divide by 2 and set their health to the result.
